ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JS1.1 Lean is a lean refinement of the successful JS1 JobGiver stutter-reduction build for RimWorld 1.5. JS1 runtime data showed that broad ShouldSkip/HasJobOnCell/HasJobOnThing memoization had only a 2.5% overall hit rate, while HasJobOnThing produced most useful bool-cache hits and the original JobPackage-local nearest-order reuse was the strongest safe search optimization. JS1.1 Lean therefore preserves JS1's exact nearest-order key semantics, removes ShouldSkip and HasJobOnCell memoization, and rewrites HasJobOnThing as a lighter per-method/giver/forced bucket whose target lookup hashes only the Thing reference; Pawn identity is implicit in the one synchronous TryIssueJobPackage scope. The low-yield ParallelRegionConnectivity/RegionHint module is retired by default. ReachProfile authority, WorkPrefilter, haul accelerators, Path shadow policy, final GenClosest validation, Job creation and reservations remain unchanged and Vanilla/main-thread authoritative where applicable. No cache survives the JobPackage boundary and no worker wait is introduced.
